ctgov.note: All historical Spruce-sponsored CTgov trials are TERMINATED or COMPLETED (legacy CAH/PCOS tildacerfont program).

pipeline.modality: Recombinant fusion enzyme replacement therapy (rhNAGLU fused to IGF2 peptide); ICV administered
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from BioMarin (acquired October 2024 via APA with Allievex/AVX (ABC), LLC)

indications.indication: Mucopolysaccharidosis Type IIIB (MPS IIIB / Sanfilippo Type B)
indications.trial_name: Confirmatory Phase 3 study (planned) — placebo-controlled, 5-year, 14 patients; supported by integrated Phase 1/2 (250-201) + extensions (250-202, 250-401)
indications.trial_design: Confirmatory placebo-controlled Phase 3 study to be initiated during BLA review per FDA guidance. Prior open-label Phase 1/2 dose-escalation study and long-term extensions completed. Surrogate endpoint CSF HS-NRE accepted by FDA as reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit; primary endpoint of post-marketing trial anticipated to be BSID-C cognitive raw score.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — confirmatory Phase 3 to be initiated during BLA review; BLA submission anticipated Q4 2026
key_milestones: Initiate confirmatory Phase 3 during BLA review
FDA designations: Rare Pediatric Disease, Fast Track, Breakthrough Therapy, Orphan Drug

excluded_preclinical.reason: Preclinical; in-licensed from HBM Alpha Therapeutics in January 2025

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Study discontinued Q1 2026 following SAE (significant elevation of liver enzymes); HMNC-funded; Spruce option to in-license Cortibon not yet exercised

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: Tildacerfont (SPR001) — adult CAH glucocorticoid reduction Phase 2b
